opportunities.title: Strahd's Charm Person Loop: The One Spell That Wins Ravenloft Without a Fight

opportunities.title: 'Powered by 5E' Doesn't Mean What You Think: Munchkin RPG Edition
opportunities.why_now: Munchkin just announced it's going 5E-powered, and the term gets thrown around loosely enough to warrant a mechanical gut-check.
opportunities.angle: Dry explainer ruling: what actually carries over from the 5E chassis (d20, proficiency, classes) vs. what a licensed IP always guts, using Munchkin as the punching bag.

opportunities.title: Junk Golem Tactics: Reskinning the Flesh Golem for Scrapyard Campaigns

opportunities.angle: Creature tactic short: take the stock Flesh Golem stat block, swap fluff for scrap-metal construct, and cover the one tactic (immunity/vulnerability abuse) that actually changes at the table.

opportunities.title: Session Zero Ruling: Three Things Your Campaign Pitch Should Never Skip

opportunities.title: Paranoia's Death Rule vs. DCC's Funnel: Which Actually Kills More PCs?
opportunities.why_now: RPG Print News just resurfaced Paranoia alongside Troika!, giving a natural excuse to compare its clone-death mechanic against DCC's funnel meat-grinder.
opportunities.angle: Mechanical comparison short: two systems built to kill characters fast, one ruling from each that a GM can steal for brutal one-shots.
